title: Design System: Camora

primary.purpose: Structure: section heading text, primary actions, focus rings, sidebar accents, navy left-strip on .prep-content > h2.

primary-dark-mode.purpose: Same structural role, lifted in dark mode for contrast.

gold-leaf.purpose: Signal + momentum: agenda numerals, gold-leaf hairlines, problem counts, YOURS-tier citation badge.
gold-leaf.textSafeVariant: #7A5C0A (--cam-gold-leaf-text) for use as label text on light surfaces.

danger.purpose: Destructive states only. SonaMicButton recording state uses color-mix(in oklab, var(--danger) 14%, transparent) background.
danger.constraint: Only saturated hue beyond navy/gold permitted by the Two-Accent Rule.

neutral-light.tintNote: Surfaces tint toward cool slate. Hairlines via --border are the default container boundary; shadows are reserved for floating chrome.

neutral-dark.tintNote: Warm charcoal so the lifted navy reads correctly. Text-primary shifts to a cream #F5F0E5 (14.7:1 contrast) so dark mode never feels neon-developer.

knownDrift.issue: Pure black. Per impeccable color law: never use #000; tint every neutral toward the brand hue (chroma 0.005-0.01).
Introduces a third saturated hue (green) outside the Two-Accent Rule. Currently signals 'your past code attempts'.
knownDrift.suggestedFix: Collapse to gold-tier ('YOURS' covers both docs and code) OR shift to a darker gold (#A88817) so it sits inside the gold family.

knownDrift.issue: Two different navies named 'the brand navy'.
knownDrift.suggestedFix: Update PRODUCT.md to match #26619C, OR update code to #0047AB. PRODUCT.md is older; code is shipped, so reconciling toward #26619C is the lower-risk path.

display.purpose: Topic page section h2 — 26px Clash Display 700, tight tracking, paired with navy left-strip + gold hairline.

title.purpose: viz-caption-title — 18px Clash Display 600 — figcaption headings inside framed surfaces.

body.purpose: Topic prose — 16px Satoshi @ 1.75 line-height, max 72ch, OpenType features ss01/ss02/cv01/cv02 enabled.

body-figure.purpose: viz-caption-body — same family + size as body, slightly tighter 1.7 leading because figure captions sit inside framed surfaces.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, IDs, timers, agenda numerals — 10px JetBrains Mono 700 with 0.18em tracking, uppercase.

answer.purpose: Live interview answer prose — 16px Satoshi @ 1.7 line-height. Distinct from Capra body to give Lumora its own voice.

answer-heading.purpose: 19px Source Serif 4 — the only serif in the system, reserved for Sona's answer headings to give Lumora editorial weight.

shadows.name: shadow-xs
shadows.purpose: Default rest shadow on .btn — almost imperceptible.

extensions.shadowNote: All shadows tint with sky-blue chroma (rgb 56,189,248) for ambient cool cast — deliberate; do not switch to neutral grey.

motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: Default state-change duration. Used on background-color, border-color, color, opacity. Replaces the deprecated transition-all shorthand.

motion.name: mic-dot-pulse
motion.value: sona-mic-dot-pulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite (staggered 0.18s offset between dots)
motion.purpose: SonaMicButton transcribing state. Honors prefers-reduced-motion (becomes static at 0.6 opacity).

rules.name: Two-Accent Rule
rules.doctrine: Navy + gold are the only saturated colors that may carry meaning. State colors reuse navy (success, info) and gold (warning); only --danger introduces a third hue and only for destructive UI.

rules.name: Surface-Wash Rule
rules.doctrine: Use color-mix(in oklab, var(--token) X%, transparent) for tints. Never hardcode rgba(...).

rules.name: 16px Floor Rule
rules.doctrine: Body-mode prose never drops below 16px. Captions and labels can be 10-12px; running text never can.

rules.name: Display-For-Display-Only Rule
rules.doctrine: Clash Display is for headings and titles only. Body always belongs to Satoshi.

rules.name: Hairline-First Rule
rules.doctrine: Every container starts with a 1px var(--border) border, no shadow. Add shadow only when the element needs to read as floating above the page.

components.name: Primary Button (Ask Sona)
components.description: Navy fill, white label, mono uppercase. The primary commit affordance throughout Lumora and Capra surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--cam-primary); color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid var(--cam-primary-dk); border-radius: 8px; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 0.15s ease-out, opacity 0.15s ease-out; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--cam-primary-dk); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--bg-surface), 0 0 0 3px var(--cam-primary); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Icon Button (SonaMicButton, Back)
components.description: Square 32×32, neutral-elevated rest, focus-visible ring on the brand color.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-icon" aria-label="Voice input"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="14" height="14" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M12 1a3 3 0 00-3 3v8a3 3 0 006 0V4a3 3 0 00-3-3z"/><path d="M19 10v2a7 7 0 01-14 0v-2"/><line x1="12" y1="19" x2="12" y2="23"/><line x1="8" y1="23" x2="16" y2="23"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-icon { width: 32px; height: 32px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: var(--bg-elevated); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--text-secondary); transition: background-color 0.15s ease-out, border-color 0.15s ease-out, color 0.15s ease-out; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-icon:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--bg-surface), 0 0 0 3px var(--cam-primary); }

components.name: Tier Badge (Citations)
components.description: Tiny mono uppercase tag: 9px tracking 0.14em. Tier-coded background + text. KB navy, YOURS gold; CODE green is a known drift.
components.css: .ds-tier-badge { display: inline-block; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-tier-kb { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--cam-primary) 12%, transparent); color: var(--cam-primary); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--cam-primary) 25%, transparent); }

components.name: Visualization Figcaption
components.description: Long-form figure caption: 10px mono eyebrow, 18px display title, 16px body with OpenType features. Reading-comfort spec applied via .viz-caption-* classes in globals.css.
components.css: .viz-figure { border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--bg-surface); overflow: hidden; } /* All typography rules live in globals.css under .viz-caption / .viz-caption-eyebrow / .viz-caption-title / .viz-caption-body. */

antiReferences: Generic SaaS Academy products (pastel cards, emoji bullets)
Notion-style wikis (no hierarchy, everything looks equal weight)
Mermaid diagrams (banned project-wide; use Graphviz/Python PNGs)
